title: Debt Contracting When Borrowers Face Transitory Uncertainty: Evidence from U.S. Gubernatorial Elections
eligible_reason: The treatment 'gubern' is an election-year indicator that recurs every four years in each state (switches on and off), not a one-time adoption. Every column (Tables 3-8) includes time-varying state, borrower and deal controls (state GDP growth, per-capita GDP, unemployment, firm size, MTB, ROA, leverage, etc.), some with Heckman lambda or logit. Not a staggered-adoption design.
design_notes: Package replication_package_MS-FIN-21-03106: Readme.txt, data-prep-do-file.do, Tables-3-8.do, Table-1/2-summ-stats.do, msci-data-comp-ds.dta (loan-level Dealscan-Compustat sample, ~20,219 packages 1990-2018), msci-data-elec.dta. Regressions: reghdfe lnspread gubern $state $borrower $dealcontrols dsize dmaturity, abs(_st fyear) or abs(id fyear), clu(_st).
data_access: partial (processed loan-level file shipped; sources Dealscan/Compustat licensed)
screener_notes: Flagged 'staggered' in full text presumably because elections are staggered across states, but the treatment is cyclical.
